decision: Scan set = 2026-08-31 Drive folder (named 'Huracan Evo Spider' on Drive, IDs as briefed); one rigid levelling transform (RANSAC ground plane -> +Z, long axis -> Y, nose at -Y) applied to every scan (tools/level.py, /home/user/media/huracan-evo/level.json)

decision: Music = Oct 31 approved 240SX reel track, extended to 32.855 s by repeating 16 beats (5.596-15.697 s) at 15.697 s; cuts on even-beat accents 3.065/6.850/9.381/11.912/15.697/18.204/22.013/25.797, logo at 30.209 s

decision: Hollow wheels accepted (no fix); framing keeps wheels small/in shadow
why: Both the 2026 and the 2023 full-car scans captured only tyre rings + spoke fragments (dark rims); inventing wheels would misrepresent the scan data

decision: Five cuts moved one frame later (frames 111/219/507/579/867)

decision: src_fps per shot = 30*N/(slot+4) instead of 15
why: QA found 3-4 frozen frames before every cut: minterpolate returns 2N-3 frames, so each shot was ~0.1 s short and dur padded it by cloning. A 2-4 % time-stretch is invisible on these slow moves
